title: clear
summary: Delete saved commands, wipe history, or restore from the trash.
notes: Deleted saved commands go to a trash buffer that keeps the newest 100.
Pick items by number: `1, 3, 5`, a range `2-4`, or `all`.
Script files are moved to `~/.cwm/scripts/.trash` and moved back by `clear -r`. Files outside the scripts folder are never touched.
When a copy bank is set, the delete is applied there too, so the next sync does not bring the command back.

flags.name: -r, --restore [name]
flags.desc: Restore from trash. Without a name, list the trash and pick.

flags.name: -t, --tag <tag>
flags.desc: Clear commands with exactly this tag.

flags.name: -d, --history
flags.desc: Clear all history logs in the database.

flags.name: -a, --active <path>
flags.desc: Clear history recorded for one folder.
